name: Flywheel & Create Incompatibility
cause: The installed Flywheel mod is incompatible or conflicts with this version of Create.
solution: Disable the Flywheel mod, or upgrade to a version compatible with your Create build.

name: OptiFine & Fabric Conflict
cause: OptiFine does not run directly on Fabric, or it clashes with OptiFabric / Sodium.
solution: Instead of OptiFine and OptiFabric, use the Sodium + Iris mods. OptiFine can be disabled.

name: Insufficient RAM (Out Of Memory)
pattern: java\.lang\.OutOfMemoryError|Minecraft has run out of memory|There is insufficient memory for the Java Runtime
cause: Minecraft or its mods hit the allocated maximum RAM limit.
solution: Raise the Max RAM in Launcher Settings to at least 4G or 6G.

name: Incompatible Java Version
pattern: has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime Environment|UnsupportedClassVersionError:.*class file version (6[1-9]|7[0-9])
cause: Minecraft 1.18+ requires Java 17, and 1.20.5+ requires at least Java 21.
solution: Open the Settings tab and install Java 21 with the 1-Click Java Installer.

name: Mod Mixin Conflict
cause: Two or more mods tried to modify the same game function and collided.
solution: Temporarily disable the newest (or conflicting) mod and try again.

name: Duplicate Mod Detected
cause: Two different versions of the same mod exist in your mods folder.
solution: Delete the older duplicate from the mods folder.

name: OpenGL / GPU Driver Error
pattern: org\.lwjgl\.opengl\.OpenGLException|GLFW error 65542|WGL: The driver does not appear to support OpenGL
cause: Your GPU driver does not support OpenGL 3.2+, or the driver is outdated.
solution: Update your graphics drivers, or enable the Mesa / D3D compatibility mode.

name: Missing Sodium Dependency (Fabric/Quilt)
cause: Iris / shader mods need the Sodium rendering mod, but it is not installed.
solution: Install the Sodium mod from Modrinth (one click below).

name: Unmet Mod Dependencies (Fabric)
pattern: (?:Missing(?: or unsupported)? mandatory dependencies|Critical dependency failure|Missing mods:|Unmet dependency)
cause: A mod requires another mod dependency that is not installed.
solution: Read the mod name in the snippet below, then search and install it from Modrinth.
